recentItems.title: MOSCOW LEFT WITHOUT OIL FOR 6 MONTHS! Trump’s response and secret Zorelit V5 interceptor in action!
recentItems.description:
A country that for decades blackmailed all of Europe with energy resources is now unable to supply fuel even to its own capital! The Moscow oil refinery has completely halted primary oil processing after a devastating raid by Ukrainian drones: both key units erupted in flames, and their repair, according to Reuters, will take anywhere from several weeks to six months.

The plant supplied up to 40% of Moscow’s fuel market and almost 70% of petrol and aviation kerosene for the entire capital region. That same night, Rosneft’s Kuibyshev refinery in Samara came under fire again, delivering a final blow to the Kremlin’s fuel system.

Amid this energy crisis, a loud statement came from Washington: President Donald Trump called on Ukraine to stop striking Russian refineries. Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s response was immediate and uncompromising: Kyiv will take this step only when Russia completely stops hitting Ukraine’s critical infrastructure!
